summary: SCHMID Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about a combined order intake of more than €26 million since mid-May for its InfinityLine production equipment used in AI infrastructure and optical module supply chains. The filing does not involve a change of control, shareholder vote, or special-situation event; it is a routine operational update. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is a foreign private issuer's current report on form 6-K, equivalent to a US 8-K announcing business progress. What to watch: continued sales momentum in advanced PCB manufacturing.
